question_text: Explain why consistent member identifiers matter in a library’s loan database.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Each loan’s member reference must correspond to the intended member record. Inconsistent identifiers can disconnect or misattribute loans, so staff cannot trust who owes an item. Enforced foreign-key and update rules preserve the relationship.
